transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get started on the Cell 2 disposition. We've got 900 aluminum blanks on hold due to mixed labels from two drawing revisions. Before I record the disposition plan, I need to hear from each of you. Quality, can you walk us through your findings on the labeling mix-up? Maintenance, was there anything on the equipment side that contributed? Logistics, what's the status of the segregated inventory and any impact downstream? And product compliance, do you have any regulatory or drawing-revision concerns we need to factor in? Let's go through each one before I finalize the plan.
